capabilities: render inline badges with default, shorthand, GitHub-style, plain-text and custom syntax
make badges clickable with wikilinks or external URLs
insert badges via a searchable Insert badge command
use badges inside Markdown tables with escaped pipes
query badges with search or Dataview as a key-value store
extras: Syntax delimiters (| and :) cannot appear in badge values; the README explains a workaround for tables. Icons come from Lucide, whose license is referenced. Styling is customized through CSS snippets and documented variables.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show small labeled status elements inline in text; callouts are block-level and too heavy for quick labels.

relations.evidence: Badges can act similarly to a key-value store(database) for querying via default search or Dataview plugin.
Thanks to Markdown Furigana Plugin as an example implementation of Live Preview.

summary: Renders small inline badges with icons, labels and colors in notes using a custom Markdown syntax, with a command to insert them.
